narration: Across Africa, the cost of cloud AI is not just a nuisance. Data fees, unreliable connectivity, and recurring API charges can decide who gets to learn and who gets left behind.
caption: Cloud costs and unreliable connectivity turn AI access into a privilege.

narration: CodeFellow changes that. It is an offline coding tutor built for the laptop students already have. Learn, debug, and build. No internet required.
caption: CodeFellow: an offline coding tutor for everyday laptops.

narration: Here, a learner asks CodeFellow to implement a Python function. The model runs locally, preserves the exact contract, returns executable code, and explains the approach. No cloud service touches the prompt.
caption: Exact contract. Executable Python. A short teaching explanation.

narration: Now the same workflow in Kiswahili, with the natural code switching programmers use. Function names and technical terms stay intact, while the learner can ask in the language used in the classroom.
caption: Kiswahili plus natural programming code-switching, inside the model.

narration: CodeFellow is more than code generation. Its hint first tutor reads a learner selected file, combines local diagnostics and test evidence, then explains the next fix without silently changing the source. This is a real run against the included JavaScript bug.
caption: A genuine local run: diagnostics-grounded, hint-first debugging.

narration: Under the hood, we trained on ten thousand verified examples. English, Kiswahili, and code switched versions share identical executable solutions. Programs are compiled, edge cases are tested, and mutation testing rejects weak examples.
caption: Correct code is locked across languages, executed, and mutation-tested.

narration: The final three billion parameter model is compressed for CPU inference. On our official local profiler run, it generated 4.72 tokens per second, used 3.29 gibibytes of peak memory, and stayed below the seven gigabyte limit without a GPU.
caption: Measured locally: 4.72 tokens per second and 3.29 GiB peak memory.

narration: A student, bootcamp, or technical college can now provide private, repeatable programming support on an ordinary laptop. Coding assistance becomes programming education, and Kiswahili support is inside the model, not bolted on through a translator.
caption: Private programming education for students, bootcamps, and technical colleges.

narration: CodeFellow is open, reproducible, and ready for audit. Learn, debug, and build. No internet required.
caption: Learn, debug, and build — no internet required.
